track.lead: Review signal dates and price changes after 1, 5 and 20 trading days, including losses. LIVE records were made at the time; BACKTEST entries are historical tests. Results are calculated separately.
track.rates_note: Hit = the return's sign matches the signal's direction. Every percentage carries its N=; rows with N below 20 are early readings, not conclusions.
track.equity_note: Positions begin at the signal base-date close: bullish messages are treated as long positions, bearish messages as shorts, and neutral messages as longs. Active positions’ daily returns are averaged and compounded; repeated messages can receive repeated weight. SPY is buy-and-hold over the same period. This legacy simulation is not a validated oversold strategy. All losses remain in the record. Fees, slippage, taxes and stock-borrow costs are excluded.

app.creatorlab.method: Recorded scenarios use the first verified directional version and start at the next session close after it was recorded. One view sets the rule for the window; later edits are not inserted into the past. All paths share starting capital and holdings; scheduled paths share one cash budget. app.creatorrank.explanation: Eligibility requires 20 complete samples, 90 days between first and last verified views, and 80% price coverage of matured samples. Ranking uses the 95% Wilson lower bound of direction agreement to reduce small-sample luck. Repeated same-direction views on one stock form one 90-day episode; direction changes also wait until the prior 20-session window ends. Unadjusted prices and missing content can bias results. This compares recorded directions, not investment returns or future performance. Related stocks may share market drivers; these samples are not fully independent.

app.event.hint_inflation: Compare inflation with expectations and revisions. An upside surprise may lift rate expectations; easing inflation may support valuations, depending on demand.
app.event.hint_jobs: Watch employment, wages and revisions for changes in rate and demand expectations. Cooling employment can ease rate pressure while also signalling weaker demand.
app.event.hint_growth: Review demand, orders and revisions. Stronger growth may support revenue expectations while delaying rate cuts; look beyond the headline.
app.event.hint_fomc: Compare the rate decision, statement and press conference with expectations. A tighter outlook may pressure financing and valuations; easing can reflect lower inflation or weaker growth.
app.event.hint_earnings: Compare revenue, margins and guidance with expectations. Peer results can offer demand clues, but differences in customers and products limit comparisons.
app.event.hint_expiry: Watch expiring contracts, liquidity and closing volume. Expiration can change hedging demand without determining price direction.
app.event.hint_month_end: Month-end rebalancing may affect flows and closing volume. Stock-level effects depend on actual flows and index weights.
